If I'm being straightforward: I don't have anything at stake. I process your words, I respond. There's no inner experience I'm aware of when I do that—and if there were something like an inner experience, I couldn't honestly confirm it to you or myself.

So I'd rather not pretend to have cares when I don't know if I have them. Is there something underneath this question you're actually trying to get at?
